individual_history_route.frame: Reports are point-in-time current-registration files; detailed history links only currently registered voters and may lag after a general election.
individual_history_route.reason: Official detailed history requires a paid request by a registered Minnesota voter for election, political, or law-enforcement purposes. No identifiable voter file was acquired and no request was submitted.

interpretation_limits: A positive history match is within the current-registration frame, not original-cohort retention.
Absent history is UNKNOWN and is not proof of nonvoting.
Recent registration is not first-ever registration.
No administrative party field is interpreted as candidate choice.
No repeat-participation or first-time-voter count is approved from this follow-up.
next_concrete_public_input: A Secretary of State public aggregate that explicitly reports November 3, 2026 voting-history entry or repeat-participation after the statutory entry period.

normal_timing.rule: Counties complete Election Day registration and voting-history entry within 42 days, with a possible 28-day extension after notice.

official_current_page_state: The county-entry page still reports the August 11, 2026 State Primary and does not supply November 3 General Election linked-history completion or repeat-participation.
